listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (MacNativeGames)
listing.summary: An early Breath of the Wild Apple ARM64 rewrite with shared Horizon/NVN-to-Metal services and a local builder. The project reports Mac 1.6.0/1.9.0 opening, saves, Great Plateau and selected DLC scenes, with scene/version-specific performance and audio. iPhone 1.6.0 was played; iOS 1.9.0 was built but unplayed, and no visionOS route is established. Apple Silicon Mac needs macOS 26+/Metal 4; iOS needs 26+ and iPhone 14+. Python 3.14 build_app.py builds a local app or an IPA to sign/sideload; there is no published release. Back up the profile before rebuilding and launching an update; rollback does not establish backward save compatibility. Supply your own title 01007EF00011E000 base plus matching 1.6.0 or 1.9.0 NSP/NSZ update, prod.keys and firmware/shared fonts. Combined 1.6.0 cards with DLC or separate base/update without DLC are accepted. Optional 1.9.0 DLC titles 01007EF00011F001/002 must be supplied separately. Other update hashes are refused. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
